topic: YouTube moves Subscriptions out of the mobile bottom bar; Subs joins the Home top bar

verified_facts.fact: Subs (formerly Subscriptions) feed moves to the top bar on the Home tab
Subscriptions was in the bottom bar for nearly a decade (2017); Android and iOS; Subs second after Home
Live, Music, Movies & TV feeds; Movies & TV only with active paid content such as Primetime Channels
Custom feeds via +; up to 3 active (free), up to 8 (Premium); example 'guided meditations under 10 minutes'
Custom feeds rolling out in English to U.S. signed-in viewers; no date given for the navigation change
May 2026 test moved Subscriptions to the top; YouTube confirmed the experiment; users pushed back

explicitly_NOT_claimed: what fills the freed bottom-bar slot
that every user has the layout today
